terminalBasics.heading: ── Terminal Basics ──
terminalBasics.body:
SSH/SFTP remote access (password / key / Expect-Send login)
ProxyJump — direct SSH+SFTP to a jump target via primary host
Local shells (PowerShell, CMD, Git Bash, WSL)
Default shell setting / per-minitab shell selection
Theme / font / encoding (utf-8/cp949/euc-kr) change
Auto-reconnect (30s), initial connection watchdog (20s × 3 retries)
Terminal transparency (0–100 slider) / desktop see-through / Alt+Enter fullscreen

workspacePanel.heading: ── Workspace / Panels ──
workspacePanel.body:
Multiple workspace tabs
Split panels (horizontal / vertical / tile ⊞ N×ceil√N)
Floating zoom (full-screen panel overlay)
Per-panel minitabs, drag-and-drop between tabs
Minitab wheel scrolling / ‹ › buttons
Per-tab selected-panel memory (auto-focus on re-entry)
Click-focus on selected panel → file tree / Claude context auto-switch

sessionMgmt.heading: ── Session Management ──
sessionMgmt.body:
Mixed folder + session sorting (Ctrl+↑/↓ move, multi-select)
Shift+click range select / Ctrl+click multi-select
Session import / export (SecureCRT, Xshell)
Re-click session to toggle encoding popup
host:port hover floating tooltip
Folder expand/collapse state persisted across app restarts
Session editor:
  - Initial file-tree path
  - ProxyJump host configuration
  - File tree auto-follow option (sync on cd)
  - Login script (Expect/Send)

remoteExplorer.heading: ── Remote File Explorer / Editor (VS Code Remote style) ──
remoteExplorer.body:
Workspace-shared file tree (based on selected panel's session)
File tree pin / auto-hide (📌 toggle)
File tree width drag-resize (160–800px)
SFTP listing, mtime sort, per-extension color/icons (15+ categories)
Multi-select (Ctrl/Shift+click) + bulk download
Context menu: Open / Attach to Claude / Copy path / Delete
Monaco editor tabs (syntax highlight, Ctrl+S save)
Dual-pane file explorer (SFTP/local both ways) + ProxyJump support

claudeIntegration.heading: ── Claude Code Integration ──
claudeIntegration.body:
Right-side Claude chat sidebar (pin / auto-hide, drag resize)
When session / file tree / Claude all unpinned, z-index follows mouse hover
WebDAV bridge — mount remote SSH as a local UNC path in real time
Automatic Unix→UNC path translation (/view/... → \\127.0.0.1@port\...)
MCP ssh_exec — Claude runs remote SSH commands (cleartool etc.)
Model selection (Opus / Sonnet / Haiku / Opus Plan)
Permission modes (confirm before edit / auto-accept / plan / allow all)
Plan mode + ExitPlanMode approval modal (Markdown + Mermaid render)
PreToolUse-hook based per-tool approval (checkboxes)
Resume conversation sessions (--resume) + automatic fallback on stale
Local file/folder attach (📄+ / 📁+ webkitdirectory recursive)
Slash command palette (Context/Model/Permission/Slash, filter + ↑↓ navigation)
Live tool timeline indicator (⏳/✓/✕)
Independent chat font setting + Ctrl+Wheel size adjust
Conversation history management (Pinned / Recents, rename, pin, delete)
Background conversation — keeps receiving responses even after starting a new chat
Fork conversation (right-click message → Fork from here, previous transcript injected)
Message right-click menu (copy text / markdown, attach context, fork)
Mermaid diagrams auto SVG render + right-click save/copy as PNG/SVG
GFM tables auto-render (tab-aligned text also auto-converted)
AskUserQuestion / ToolSearch tools blocked (non-interactive mode stability)
Per-requestId process isolation — multiple concurrent conversations, accurate stop

vNewly.heading: ── v2.0.6 New ──
vNewly.body:
PWD auto-follow background polling — zero shell history (separate SSH exec channel polling /proc/PID/cwd)
Rounded corners on session / file tree / Claude sidebar triggers
Workspace tabs reorder by drag
Minitab right-side controls toggle (⋯ button) — floating popup for split / float / transparency
Terminal context menu now includes theme change (per-term)
Mermaid diagrams save/copy as PNG/SVG via right-click menu
Plan approval modal also auto-renders Mermaid
GFM tables + tab-aligned text auto-conversion
Broadcast bar / file-transfer session dropdown: 🟢 connected / ⚪ disconnected grouping
Fixed: simple titlebar click would restore maximized window (5px drag threshold)
Terminal vi etc. full-screen apps sync size immediately — refit skips hidden terminals
Fixed: Alt+Enter maximize + minitab float toggle would blank the view
Help / info modals scrollable, auto-restores terminal focus on close
Auto-focus terminal when window regains focus (Alt+Tab etc.)

inputBroadcast.heading: ── Input / Broadcast ──
inputBroadcast.body:
Bulk text send (current / visible-tab / connected / all-sessions lazy connect)
Quick-connect bar (host / user / password / enc instant connection)
Ctrl+C / Ctrl+D broadcast
Broadcast history (↑↓ navigation)
Esc does not close the bar — close via ✕ button only

search.heading: ── Find / Search ──
search.body:
Terminal find (Ctrl+Shift+F), history, highlight
Previous / next navigation

settings.heading: ── Settings (Options) ──
settings.body:
Default local shell selection
Register/unregister Explorer right-click "Open here"
Change session storage path
Keybinding customization
Terminal settings (word separator, scrollback, etc.)
Built-in manual viewer (docs/MANUAL.md)

windowsIntegration.heading: ── Windows System Integration ──
windowsIntegration.body:
Frameless / transparent / maximize-restore window
Explorer "Open here" → workspace shell in that directory

techStack.heading: ── Tech Stack ──
techStack.body:
Electron + React + TypeScript + Vite
xterm.js (terminal), Monaco Editor (code editor)
node-pty (local shell), ssh2 (SSH/SFTP)
webdav-server (SFTP→WebDAV proxy)
marked (Markdown), iconv-lite (encoding)
Claude Code CLI (@anthropic-ai/claude-code)
